The '''ambush''' on [[Ral's Run]] occurred when [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] tried to attack an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]], but found the ''[[Imperial Protector]]'' instead. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] fighters managed to destroy the escort carrier.

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ambush was mentioned in the opening story in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook [[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']], released in [[2015]].
